english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for courage, especially the resolve to face fear or keep going despite difficulty.
This is the all-purpose noun for courage or bravery.
This is the all-purpose choice for courage or fortitude.

examples.english: Despite such a big setback, they still had the courage to start over.
examples.traditional: 面對咁大嘅挫折，佢仲有勇氣重新開始。
